import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    if not s:
        return
    t = s[0]
    f1 = True
    i = 1
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        # Check for "at" replacement (only once, not at the last two characters)
        if i != n - 2 and s[i] == 'a' and i + 1 < n and s[i+1] == 't' and f1:
            t += '@'
            i += 2
            f1 = False
            continue
        # Check for "dot" replacement (not at the last three characters)
        if i != n - 3 and s[i] == 'd' and i + 2 < n and s[i+1] == 'o' and s[i+2] == 't':
            t += '.'
            i += 3
            continue
        t += s[i]
        i += 1
    sys.stdout.write(t + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
